text.id: Dermaganya panjang, dan setengah kapal di sini dicat biru-putih. Setengahnya lagi digantungin ban bekas di haluannya. Foto pesisir_77 tiba-tiba kerasa nggak ada gunanya.
text.en: The pier is long, and half the boats here are painted blue and white. The other half have old tires hanging off their bows. pesisir_77's photo suddenly feels useless.

text.id: Di ujung dermaga ada pos syahbandar kecil dengan papan pengumuman yang udah pudar. "DAFTAR KAPAL TERDAFTAR, DERMAGA III." Tulisannya kecil-kecil, diketik, ditempel pake selotip.
text.en: At the end of the pier there's a small harbor office with a faded notice board. "REGISTERED VESSELS, PIER III." Small typed print, held up with tape.

text.id: Petugas di pos itu bapak-bapak gendut yang lagi nonton sinetron di HP. Dia nggak ngangkat kepala.
text.en: The man in the office is a heavyset guy watching a soap opera on his phone. He doesn't look up.

text.id: "Nyari kapal? Nomor registrasinya berapa, Mas? Saya cek pemiliknya."
text.en: "Looking for a boat? What's the registration number? I'll look up the owner."

text.id: Di foto, haluannya bilang "SRI REJ", terus ketutup ban. Di bawahnya "No. 14", terus ketutup lagi.
text.en: In the photo, the bow says "SRI REJ", then the tire covers it. Under that, "No. 14", then covered again.

text.id: Nomor registrasi kapal di foto?
text.en: The registration number of the boat in the photo?

text.id: "Nggak ada di dermaga ini, Mas," kata petugasnya, masih ngelihatin sinetronnya.
text.en: "That one's not at this pier," the man says, still watching his show.

text.id: Dua hal di foto. Namanya. Nomornya. Dua-duanya setengah. Tapi dua setengah bisa jadi satu.
text.en: Two things in the photo. The name. The number. Both half hidden. But two halves can make one.

text.id: "Sri Rejeki 2? Itu punya Haji Darmo. Kapalnya lagi naik dok dari bulan lalu, Mas. Nggak ke mana-mana."
text.en: "Sri Rejeki 2? That's Haji Darmo's. It's been in dry dock since last month. Hasn't gone anywhere."

text.id: Namanya cocok. Tapi nomor di foto mulai dari empat belas.
text.en: The name fits. But the number in the photo starts with fourteen.

text.id: "Itu bukan kapal biru-putih, Mas. Itu kapal merah."
text.en: "That's not a blue and white boat. That one's red."

text.id: Nomornya mulai dari empat belas, iya. Tapi namanya harus "Sri Rej".
text.en: It starts with fourteen, sure. But the name has to start "Sri Rej".

text.id: Gue jejerin dua-duanya di kepala. Yang namanya mulai "Sri Rej" ada dua. Yang nomornya mulai "14" cuma satu di antara dua itu.
text.en: I line both up in my head. Two names start with "Sri Rej". Only one of those two has a number starting "14".

text.id: Satu, empat, dua, tujuh.
text.en: One, four, two, seven.

text.id: Petugasnya akhirnya ngangkat kepala.
text.en: The man finally looks up.

text.id: "Sri Rejeki? Punya Pak Hendra. Dulu punya abangnya, Pak Karta. Pak Karta udah nggak melaut dari stroke tahun lalu, jadi kapalnya dipegang adiknya."
text.en: "Sri Rejeki? That's Pak Hendra's. It used to be his older brother's, Pak Karta. Pak Karta hasn't been out since his stroke last year, so his brother took the boat."

text.id: Pak Karta.
text.en: Pak Karta.

text.id: Kapalnya Pak Karta. Kapal yang berangkat jam setengah enam pagi, setahun lalu, tanpa gue.
text.en: Pak Karta's boat. The boat that left at five thirty in the morning, a year ago, without me.

text.id: "Pak Hendra biasanya di ujung, deket tiang lampu, siang-siang benerin jaring," kata petugasnya. "Orangnya nggak suka ngobrol, Mas. Jangan kaget."
text.en: "Pak Hendra's usually at the far end, by the lamp post, fixing nets around noon," the man says. "He doesn't like to talk. Don't take it personally."
